excerpt.zh: 星海参议院里忘恩负义的傻瓜们投票结束我们作为监管人的任期！我们被剥夺了所有的相关职责。
excerpt.en: The ungrateful fools in the Galactic Senate have voted to terminate our Custodianship! We have been stripped of all Community powers that were associated with the office.

texts.zh: 星海参议院里忘恩负义的傻瓜们投票结束我们作为监管人的任期！我们被剥夺了所有的相关职责。
texts.en: The ungrateful fools in the Galactic Senate have voted to terminate our Custodianship! We have been stripped of all Community powers that were associated with the office.

texts.zh: 在通过突然且充满羞辱的方式剥夺了他们的监管权之后，星海参议院多数投票统一立即将[From.GetName]从星海监管人职位移除。他们被剥夺了星海共同体赋予的特殊权力。
texts.en: In a sudden and humiliating end to their Custodianship, the Galactic Senate majority has voted to immediate remove the [From.GetName] from the office of Galactic Custodian. They have been stripped of their special Community powers.

tooltips.en: The [From.GetName] are no longer Custodians of the Galactic Community.

label.en: That is the end of that.

tooltips.en: The [From.GetName] are no longer Custodians of the Galactic Community.

title.zh: 泛星系防卫军暂停行动

texts.zh: 由于星海监管人的职位现在空缺，泛星系防卫军设立了一个独立的指挥架构。他们依然致力于保护星海共同体，泛星系防卫军的指挥高层宣誓将继续巡逻成员国的恒星系。
texts.en: With the office of the Galactic Custodian now vacant, the Galactic Defense Force has established an independent command structure. They remain dedicated towards the protection of the Community, and GDF High Command has vowed to maintain their patrols of member systems.

label.zh: 他们的警觉令人肃然起敬。
